$comment: Every user-facing sentence the hooks emit. Override any subset via rules.messagesPath in config — unlisted keys keep these shipped defaults. {target}, {counts}, and {cap} are filled at runtime.
rewriteInstruction: Rewrite the flagged text per the communication rules, then retry the tool call.
escapeHatch: If a flagged term is a precise domain term in this project, suggest that the user run: /just-say-so:allow "<collocation>" — quote the flagged term as it appears in the text (for example "robust regression", not "robust"). The term goes to the project's Vale vocabulary.
warnInstruction: The call was allowed; fix the flagged text per the communication rules.
advisoryLabel: advisories (replace with a measurement or a concrete consequence)
configAskReason: just-say-so: this edits a just-say-so/Vale policy file ({target}). Allow only if you asked for this change.
outputIntro: just-say-so: Vale reports errors in your last reply:
outputRewrite: Rewrite the reply per the communication rules.
replyReportIntro: Recent replies broke these rules (rule, count, and the matched term when it is a fixed one):
replyReportInstruction: Apply the rules to your next replies. Do not revise, repeat, or mention earlier replies, and do not acknowledge this note.
valeEditIntro: just-say-so: Vale reports {counts} in the lines this edit added to {target}:
valeWholeFileIntro: just-say-so: Vale reports {counts} in {target} (whole file — this write created or replaced it):
valeFixInstruction: Fix the errors before finishing. Treat warnings and suggestions as advice.
valeTruncated: (report truncated — run vale on the file for the full list)
rulesAlsoEnforced: This project also enforces these Vale rules at error level: {rules}.
valeChatSectionDead: just-say-so: the Vale config has a {sections} section. Chat lints as reply.reply and published text as <source>.<tool>.<field>.publish since 0.9.0, so that section matches nothing. Rename it to [*.reply] or [*.publish].
valeFormatsMissing: just-say-so: the Vale config does not map the reply and publish extensions to Markdown, so chat and published text lint as plain text (code spans included). Add the JustSaySo package to Packages and run vale sync, or add [formats] with reply = md and publish = md.
valeMissing: just-say-so: checks are configured but the vale binary is missing from PATH, or is not errata-ai vale. Install it (brew install vale) or set files.mode, publish.mode, and reply.mode to "off".
legacyConfigKeys: just-say-so: {file} sets {keys}, which 0.9.0 no longer reads. The config is keyed by target now (files, publish, reply, rules). See the README section Upgrading from 0.8.x.
publishIntro: just-say-so: Vale alerts in text published by {target}:
publishUnresolvedAsk: just-say-so: {target} publishes text the checker cannot read before the call: {constructs}. Allow only if the published text follows the communication rules. Put the text in a flag value or a file to get it checked.
publishUnresolvedDeny: just-say-so: {target} publishes text the checker cannot read before the call: {constructs}. publish.unresolved is "deny". Put the text in a flag value or a file the checker can read, then retry.
stopGateIntro: just-say-so: error-level Vale alerts remain in files this session wrote:
stopGateWaived: just-say-so: the same Vale errors remain after a rewrite; not blocking again. These alerts are waived for the rest of this session. To exempt a term for good, run /just-say-so:allow "<collocation>"; to exempt the file, add its path to .vale.ini with an empty BasedOnStyles.
outputWaived: just-say-so: the same Vale errors remain in the reply after a rewrite; not blocking again.
manifestUnreadable: just-say-so: rules.manifest names {file}, which {error}. The shipped rules are in force until it is fixed; /just-say-so:doctor shows the details.
